name: Ar Rasheed
description: Allah guides with wisdom to what is right; His guidance is free from error.
summary: Ar Rasheed expresses wise direction towards what is right. The root is r-sh-d (ر ش د), relating to right guidance. Quran 18:10 records a request to Allah for right guidance in one's affairs; it does not use Ar Rasheed as a divine name or imply that Allah receives guidance from another.
